title: 挂杯：抓杯体—测把手孔/挂钩—局部坐标对齐—穿入承重释放
phases: Identify three mugs, each handle aperture and unoccupied rack pegs; preserve mug/peg assignment.
Pick the mug body/rim leaving its handle aperture free. Inspect current carried mug.
Use three fresh multiview handle/peg frame features for dock. Destination mate frame describes entry alignment; seat is at the actual hanging support, not the peg tip.
Local dock aligns, enters axially, advances to measured seat, releases and withdraws.
Inspect that handle remains supported and mug clears table; fallen mug is recovery, not completion.
Repeat all three; place/recover any held failures on visible support before final home.
failure_lesson: Accepted peg approach or insertion did not prove engagement; several external manual releases slipped. Repeated contour-stereo calls all failed in reviewed traces.
reference_success_scope: External aggregate includes rare success, but cached detailed notes did not establish a successful release recovery.
